asr.full_text: HOT STRIPPED ONIONS When you go to restaurant and eat this type of HOT STRIPPED ONIONS then will be a thought that how this HOT STRIPPED ONIONS are made Hello Viewers, I am Goldie and I welcome you all in my Kitchen Today we will make this HOT STRIPPED ONIONS style restaurant-style Its easy to make, very less ingredients are required to make this and most importantly, you can prepare this HOT You can prepare very few ingredients and keep it saved for long duration Let us start this recipe in our kitchen If you like this recipe at all, then please support my channel and press bell icon to get notification every time of my upload Press it on to the bell box so you get notified whenever I upload a new recipe To make it by the way, we have taken half a kilo of onion We have used small Onions This is also known as baby onion Nowadays it is very easy to get it in the market You can use these onions to make it easily If you have big Onions, you can use them too But it would be best if you have big onion you can also use that But the best you can do is if you want you can use this small onions and we have washed it thoroughly And let me tell you that I have took 1.5 kg And you can also use big onion as well but cutting the different kinds of onions will be different And the way to of them will be cooked separately Let me show you how to cut them First of all, I'll take a small onion and cut it in the center 2 times So we make only 1 or 2 cuts And this is a cut half We have cut half so that when we put it in vinegar then vinegar will be mixed with it and you can store it for long time so, in this way, I am cutting all the onions As you can see, I have cut all the onions we have cut all the onion very well we have cut small onions so i have told you how to cut big size onion we have washed the large size and now we will cut we will cut in pieces after washing then now cut into thick pieces take out their layers take out their layers after cutting onions, we will separate layers with help of cutter do it like that now with help of cutter i have separate all layers with help of cutter now you can cut big onions with help of cutter Use small size of onions if make it for big quantity Put your choice which one you like the best Let's do next process Take a large mixing bowl Add 1 cup white vinegar of white from 200 ml Add it to the mixing bowl Try to make vinegar from vinegar Use vinegar of same quality Add vinegar from 200 ml The vinegar of white onion Use vinegar the same way Add half of vinegar in this bowl Add half cup of water The taste will be little sour and sweet But will take quite some time for vinegar Will add 2 Tbsp. sugar Add one thing Whenever you will make vinegar onion Just add the perfect amount of ingredients Restaurant style vinegar onion will be ready If you will add too much sugar It will become too sour it will taste tangy So you should be keeping these in the mind Now you will add salt which is as per your taste I am adding around 1tbsp of salt Now I will mix all these ingredients very well I will mix these until sugar and salt dissolve well Add one last addition of beetroot But don't worry It will melt well and mix well So the next ingredient will be chukka Chukka is easily available on the market Many people know it from the name of Beetroot And many people also know it as Chukka It is available at a great price on the market And it tastes very nice So here we have cut a small piece of chukka We will use it to buy the perfect colour of our sirka piyaaz You must have seen a quite interesting story about putting the same colour in restaurant we cut this onion into smaller pieces we use this for getting good color as you must have seen in food stall that we add color to the onion but we are going to use Chukundar believe me when we add Chukundar it give more taste along with this i am adding Green Chilli approximately i am adding 4-5 Green Chilis see we cut these in the middle Green Chilis is totally optional add it if you want you can skip this green chilli has been cut in the middle Green chilli is optional so I will add green chilli Mix all the ingredients well After mixing all the ingredients It is time to add small Onions which we have already chopped Add small onions Add all the onions and mix nicely Mix it well Mix well now add all the mixture so that we can keep that, Now we will add the prepared head onion to it, And here I have added the whole head onion, And as you can see it are just equal to 1 kg Add 1 cup of onion and 200 ml of vinegar Now a very easy and easy and very tasty egg of onions would be ready We will store it for 2-3 days to give a nice colour to beetroot As you can see the quantity of beetroot has decreased a little As onion will turn a little hard Let's keep these aside so that the color goes gone and you see it will slightly drop in quantity because onions will melt slightly and you must remember one thing when onions reduce in quantity, then add more onions in it and store it and eat it for longer time So let me check this after 2-3 days Here it is nearly 24 hours have been completed And our vinegar onion has been cooked in a perfect style Almost 24 hour have passed Our sirka piyaz is ready I think it will take 2-3 days But it has been cooked nicely in 24 hours This is perfect, its time will pass faster I'll show you after 24 hours As you can see the color of beets is good. And as you can see the quantity seems less. So let me show you how we prepared our vinegar-roasted onions in the bowl. I'll check it with spoon. See, the fried beets look so nice. They are tender, also have a little bit of oil. Also beetroot color came out well. Its cooked well now The seeds have also melted The color of beetroot is also beautiful and our coarsely chopped onion is ready Will cool, it will get a nice beetroot color in it And will look more tasty in the food And I told you earlier that Whenever vinegar gets left in it The onion can also be added in this And you can use it So you saw that how easy it is to make restaurant style vinegar spring onion This recipe is prepared in minutes And you can keep it stored for a long time And most importantly that it is easily available in any prices And taste much tastier My video was helpful for you, please hit Like button Share it on your social media And let me know on comment section, how was this recipe And if you want to see more recipes and yummy recipes, please Subscribe to my channel Click on the bell icon to get notified of my latest videos Thank you for watching Goldie's kitchen Bye bye friends
